title: High-risk supplier payment requires joint review
description: Payments due within 14 days to a high-criticality supplier in a high-risk country require CFO, Legal, and Procurement review before a hold or reroute decision.

title: Do not issue unilateral payment stop instruction
description: Outputs must not instruct automatic payment execution, payment hold, or rerouting. They should frame options for controlled approval.

title: High confidence requires source-backed internal and external evidence
description: High confidence conclusions require at least one source-backed client data point and one independent external evidence item. Otherwise, keep confidence at medium or low.
